info.title: SchoolLedger API
info.description: Headless Student Information & Academic Management System. Concurrency-safe enrollment, immutable grade ledger, signed document issuance.

get.summary: Liveness probe.
Readiness probe: database round-trip + Redis presence.

post.summary: Password login. Returns tokens, or an MFA challenge when TOTP is enabled.

expiresInSeconds.description: Access token lifetime in seconds (15 minutes).

post.summary: Complete an MFA login challenge with a TOTP code.

expiresInSeconds.description: Access token lifetime in seconds (15 minutes).

post.summary: Rotate a refresh token. Reuse of a rotated token revokes the whole family.

expiresInSeconds.description: Access token lifetime in seconds (15 minutes).

post.summary: Revoke the session family of the presented refresh token.
Revoke every session family for the current user.
Step-up MFA: exchange a TOTP code for an access token elevated for 5 minutes.

expiresInSeconds.description: Access token lifetime in seconds (15 minutes).

post.summary: Begin TOTP enrollment. Returns the shared secret and otpauth URL.
Confirm TOTP enrollment with the first generated code.

get.summary: Current user profile with roles, student profile and MFA state.

post.summary: Create a user (optionally with a student profile). ADMIN only.

get.summary: List users. ADMIN and REGISTRAR only.

post.summary: Place a hold on a student. FINANCIAL: CASHIER/REGISTRAR/ADMIN; DISCIPLINARY & DOCUMENTARY: REGISTRAR/ADMIN.

get.summary: List holds of a student.

post.summary: Lift a hold. REGISTRAR/ADMIN (FINANCIAL also CASHIER).
Create a department. REGISTRAR/ADMIN.
Create a program. REGISTRAR/ADMIN.
Create a curriculum version (prospectus). REGISTRAR/ADMIN.
Transition curriculum status DRAFT → ACTIVE → ARCHIVED. REGISTRAR/ADMIN.
Create a course. REGISTRAR/ADMIN.
Place a course in the curriculum grid. REGISTRAR/ADMIN.
Create/update a course requisite. Rejected when it would introduce a cycle (DAG_CYCLE_DETECTED).

get.summary: Curriculum DAG view: courses, requisites, topological order, unlock counts.

post.summary: Create an academic term with enrollment and grading windows. REGISTRAR/ADMIN.

get.summary: List terms.

post.summary: Advance the term state machine (PLANNING → ENROLLMENT → ADD_DROP → ONGOING → GRADING → CLOSED).
Create a room. REGISTRAR/ADMIN.

get.summary: List rooms.

post.summary: Create a section with conflict-checked schedules. REGISTRAR/ADMIN.
Add a schedule slot to a section (conflict-checked, GiST-enforced). REGISTRAR/ADMIN.
Open/close/cancel a section. REGISTRAR/ADMIN.

get.summary: List sections of a term (optionally filtered by course) with schedules and live counts.
Section detail with course, term, instructor and schedules.
Curriculum eligibility: eligible / blocked (with missing prerequisite IDs) / already passed / consumed courses.

post.summary: Atomic multi-section slot reservation. Idempotency-Key required.
post.description: Admission control runs in Redis (atomic Lua: capacity + schedule overlap), the authoritative commit runs in Postgres with deterministic row locks (section id ASC). Capacity can never be exceeded (INV-1).

allowOverload.description: REGISTRAR/ADMIN only: allow exceeding the max academic unit load

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Idempotency key for safely retrying writes (required on flagged endpoints).

post.summary: Drop an enrollment item (or leave a waitlist). Triggers waitlist auto-promotion when a slot frees up.
Join the FIFO waitlist of a full section.

get.summary: Current enrollment for a term (items, sections, assessment).
FIFO waitlist of a section. REGISTRAR/ADMIN/INSTRUCTOR.

post.summary: Manually run waitlist promotion for a section (worker does this automatically on drops). REGISTRAR/ADMIN.

get.summary: Immutable tuition assessment breakdown for an enrollment.

post.summary: Mark an assessment as PAID (freezes the breakdown). CASHIER/ADMIN.

put.summary: Create/update DRAFT grade entries for a section. Assigned INSTRUCTOR (or ADMIN).

get.summary: Grade sheet detail (entries + student names). Staff only; INSTRUCTOR must own the section.

post.summary: Submit a DRAFT sheet for verification. Assigned INSTRUCTOR (or ADMIN), step-up MFA required.
Verify a SUBMITTED sheet (PROGRAM_CHAIR/ADMIN).
Return a SUBMITTED/VERIFIED sheet to DRAFT with a note (PROGRAM_CHAIR/REGISTRAR/ADMIN).
Post a VERIFIED sheet to the immutable ledger (REGISTRAR/ADMIN, step-up MFA). This is the point of no return.

get.summary: Full grade ledger incl. superseded versions and hash chain (BSL-302).
Term + cumulative GWA, academic standing and latin honors (BSL-306/307/308).

post.summary: Request rectification of a POSTED grade entry. Instructor (own section) or ADMIN.

get.summary: List rectifications (staff). Filter by status and/or target entry.

post.summary: Chair endorsement (PENDING → CHAIR_ENDORSED).
Final approval (CHAIR_ENDORSED → APPROVED). Supersedes the old entry and appends version+1. REGISTRAR/ADMIN + step-up MFA.
Reject a PENDING/CHAIR_ENDORSED rectification (Chair/Registrar/Admin).
Cancel your own PENDING rectification request.
Complete an outstanding INC with a numeric mark (Registrar/Admin + step-up MFA).
Manually run the expired-INC sweep (ADMIN). The hourly worker runs this automatically.
Request a document (COR, grade slip, TOR, certificates). Snapshot is frozen at request time. Idempotency-Key required.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Idempotency key for safely retrying writes (required on flagged endpoints).

get.summary: List document requests. STUDENT sees own; REGISTRAR/ADMIN may filter by student.
Document request detail (metadata; the frozen snapshot is rendered into the PDF, not exposed as JSON).
Presigned download URL (TTL 300s). READY documents only; every download is audited.

post.summary: Revoke a document (REGISTRAR/ADMIN). Verification reports it as invalid immediately.
Re-queue a FAILED document render (REGISTRAR/ADMIN).

get.summary: Public document verification by QR serial hash. No authentication; minimal disclosure.
Current school profile, branding and effective academic policy.

patch.summary: Update academic policy (unit load limit, grade thresholds, INC window, currency) (ADMIN).

tags.description: Grade sheets, immutable ledger, GWA, rectification, INC
